subject: File control entry
notes: LANDED 2026-10-05 (kb/Work PB773). RULE (--check 12.4.5.2 11): "Format 3 shall be specified only for a sequential file or a report file. The associated file description entry shall not be a sort-merge file description entry." TWO OBLIGATIONS, TWO ROWS with one rule-id, exactly as SR8/SR9. Sentence 2 (the SD arm): FileControlKeyRules.Rules, Entry role, ScreenedOn SortMerge, reports COBOL1900 when the SD's entry writes a clause only Format 3 prints (ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL, a RECORD DELIMITER clause). Sentence 1 (the organization arm): Entry role, ScreenedOn Indexed|Relative, reports the new COBOL2912 when an indexed or relative file's entry writes the RECORD DELIMITER clause (a report file is exempt: Format 3 is stated for it). WHICH FORMAT A CLAUSE SPECIFIES is now ONE table, FileControlKeyRules.EntryClauses, which carries per clause the SET of §12.4.5.1 formats printing it; SR8, SR9, SR11 and SR13 all read it, and FileControlKeyRuleDriftTests.EveryEntryClause_IsCarriedByExactlyTheFormatsThatPrintIt re-derives every row's set from the four printed diagrams on every run. The pre-PB773 note's premise ('one table row each') was wrong and the table gained an entry-level formats column instead (rule 5).
